dedupe_keys.name: coudlabs wp8 t812 ikt 001 permeable pavement clogging assessment using sediments with different properties

description: Goerke, Marcel at IKT ‑ Institute for Underground Infrastructure publishes raw and processed clogging-test observations for a permeable-joint pavement through Co-UDlabs. IKT and UDC test hydraulic permeability and material retention using particulate sediments with different grain sizes and plastic dust. The method follows the stated DIBt test framework; particle-size, test-results and photograph archives document the programme. Coverage is laboratory pavement specimens at IKT, Germany; exact test dates and durations are unspecified. Zenodo provides sediment, result and photograph ZIP archives plus a descriptive PDF with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is a controlled contaminant application does not establish long-term field ageing, and the data do not cover every permeable pavement construction. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
